stories.title: Enfado de Alonso con Sainz tras tocarse en Madring: «¡Me cerró contra el muro!»

en.title: Alonso upset with Sainz after contact in Madrid: "He closed me against the wall!"
en.summary: Ferrari drivers Alonso and Sainz showed camaraderie before the Madrid Formula 1 race but collided during competition, with Alonso blaming Sainz for forcing him into the wall.

stories.title: Friedrich Merz y Boris Johnson, evacuados por seguridad de un tren que precedía a otro atacado por un dron ruso a dos kilómetros de la frontera de Polonia

en.title: Friedrich Merz and Boris Johnson evacuated for security from a train preceding another attacked by Russian drone two kilometers from Poland's border
en.summary: Polish defense authorities reported that Russian drones targeting Ukraine struck locations near Polish territory, prompting security evacuations of prominent political figures from a train.

stories.title: El Valencia despide a Corberán y a Ron Gourlay, CEO de fútbol

en.title: Valencia dismisses Corberán and Ron Gourlay, football CEO
en.summary: Valencia removed head coach Carlos Corberán and sports director Ron Gourlay following a poor start to the season, with an interim replacement taking charge of the first team.

stories.title: El 'niño' Antonelli es el primer ganador en Madrid y da un nuevo bocado al Mundial; Sainz y Alonso, choque y decepción

en.title: Young Antonelli is the first winner in Madrid and takes another bite at the World Championship; Sainz and Alonso, crash and disappointment
en.summary: Antonelli won the Madrid Formula 1 race after McLaren's strategy error on Norris, with Alonso finishing 17th and Sainz retiring from the competition.

stories.title: Fallece un hombre de 80 años en los 'bous al carrer' de Vilavella tras ser corneado por un toro

en.title: 80-year-old man dies at Vilavella bull-running event after being gored by bull
en.summary: An 80-year-old man was fatally gored by a bull during the 'bous al carrer' festival in Vilavella while standing near a barricade.

stories.title: Felipe VI acude a Madring para presenciar el GP de España

en.title: King Felipe VI attends Spanish Grand Prix at Madring
en.summary: King Felipe VI attended the Formula 1 Spanish Grand Prix at Madrid's Madring circuit on September 13, accompanied by the Princess of Asturias and Infanta Sofía.

stories.title: Muere un hombre de 80 años tras alcanzarlo un toro en los "bous al carrer" en Vilavella (Castellón)

en.title: 80-year-old man dies after being struck by bull at 'bous al carrer' in Vilavella, Castellón
en.summary: An 80-year-old man died after a bull gored him multiple times during the 'bous al carrer' event in Vilavella while he stood near an iron-barred barrier.

stories.title: Antonelli reina en el sopor de Madring; Alonso, 17.º, Sainz, retirado

en.title: Antonelli dominates at Madrid; Alonso 17th, Sainz retires
en.summary: Antonelli extended his championship lead with a victory aided by a virtual safety car and a McLaren error involving Norris at the Madrid circuit.

stories.title: Felipe VI acude con la princesa Leonor y la infanta Sofía al GP de España en Madring

en.title: Felipe VI attends Spanish GP in Madrid with Princess Leonor and Infanta Sofía
en.summary: The Spanish monarch and his daughters met with Spanish racing drivers Fernando Alonso and Carlos Sainz at the Spanish Grand Prix in Madrid.

stories.title: OpenAI pospone su salida a Bolsa por la inquietud sobre los riesgos de la IA

en.title: OpenAI delays its stock market debut due to concerns about AI risks
en.summary: OpenAI will not list on public markets before 2027 at the earliest. The company's leadership states there are no financing problems or pressure to go public.

stories.title: Sam Altman paraliza la salida a bolsa de OpenAI ante los riesgos de la IA

en.title: Sam Altman halts OpenAI's stock market launch amid AI risks
en.summary: OpenAI's chief executive has ruled out a near-term public market debut for the ChatGPT creator, citing concerns about artificial intelligence risks.

stories.title: Sam Altman descarta la salida a Bolsa de OpenAI en 2026: "Dada la situación actual en materia de seguridad, no sería el momento adecuado"

en.title: Sam Altman rules out OpenAI's stock market debut in 2026: "Given the current situation regarding safety, it would not be the right moment"
en.summary: OpenAI's chief executive has stated the company will not pursue an initial public offering in 2026, citing current safety considerations as a limiting factor.

stories.title: Irán afirma que el acuerdo con Omán sobre Ormuz no implica la reapertura del paso

en.title: Iran states that Oman agreement on Hormuz does not imply reopening of the strait
en.summary: Iran's foreign minister said an agreement with Oman regarding the Strait of Hormuz will not reopen the waterway unless the United States resumes commitments from a June peace memorandum.

stories.title: Cientos de migrantes de Ceuta, trasladados a una nueva instalación acondicionada

en.title: Hundreds of migrants from Ceuta transferred to a new equipped facility
en.summary: Following violent clashes between migrants near a beach in Ceuta, Spanish National Police arrested at least two people and hospitalized two migrants with knife wounds. Authorities transferred migrants to a newly prepared facility.

stories.title: Las medidas fiscales por la guerra en Irán restan 1.812 millones a la recaudación hasta julio

en.title: Fiscal measures for Iran war cost 1.812 billion in lost revenue through July
en.summary: Spain's Treasury has foregone 1.812 billion euros in tax revenue through July due to fiscal measures introduced in March to mitigate the economic impact of Middle East conflict.

stories.title: Trump y donaciones por 84 millones a Farage sacuden la política inglesa

en.title: Trump and donations of 84 million to Farage shake British politics
en.summary: The far-right party Reform UK received two donations of 42 million euros each within two days, while the U.S. president expressed support for Irish reunification, creating political turmoil in Britain.

stories.title: Isabel Rodríguez: Casa 47 habrá puesto 100.000 pisos en alquiler en 10 años

en.title: Isabel Rodríguez: Casa 47 will have placed 100,000 rental apartments in 10 years
en.summary: The Government expects Casa 47, the public housing platform, to offer 100,000 rental apartments over a 10-year period, according to housing minister Isabel Rodríguez.
